annotations.title: Newly formed US businesses and state register lookup

description: Searches the official Secretary of State business registers of New York, Colorado, Oregon, Connecticut and Pennsylvania, in one record format. mode new is a feed of entities formed in a date window, newest first: use it for new-business leads (LLCs and corporations that just registered) and prospecting. mode search finds entities by legal name and mode lookup by the state's own entity number: use them for KYB (know your business) checks on a supplier or counterparty, to confirm it exists, its type, status (active, delinquent, inactive) and formation date. Every record links to the state's own data row. Never returns officers, directors, individual registered agents, emails, phones or street addresses: business city, state and ZIP only. Each record carries the company's website when one was found with proof (its own pages show the exact legal name and the same city or state), else 'no website found'. New York, Oregon and Pennsylvania publish active entities only, so a missing entity there may be inactive or unregistered. Pennsylvania publishes monthly, so its newest entities are weeks old. If one state fails the others still return and the failure is listed in missing.

entity_numbers.description: The state's own entity numbers, digits only, comma separated, up to 200. Required for mode lookup. Numbers are not unique across states, so pick the state too.

entity_type.description: Keep only one kind of entity: llc, corporation (for profit), nonprofit or partnership. Default any.

limit.description: Most entities to return across all states, newest first, 1 to 200. Default 50.

mode.description: new lists entities formed between since and until, newest first (the default). search finds entities whose legal name contains name. lookup fetches entities by entity_numbers.

name.description: Part of a legal business name, not case sensitive. Required for mode search; in mode new it narrows the feed.

since.description: Earliest formation date, YYYY-MM-DD. In mode new it defaults to 7 days ago. In other modes it applies only when given.

states.description: Registers to read: any of NY, CO, OR, CT, PA, comma separated (an array also works). Default all five.

status.description: Keep only active, active_or_delinquent or inactive entities. Default any. New York, Oregon and Pennsylvania are skipped for inactive.

until.description: Latest formation date, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. In mode new it defaults to today.
